title: 第十四章 突破灵动第十五章 主修空间道
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 这时，冯斗不断地炼丹，不断地成功，不断地失败，越来越多的丹药被炼出来的，被他收在空间戒里。
然而慢慢地冯斗对于中级丹药的炼制熟练度越来越高，而且偶尔还试过炼制出过一些类似高级的丹药，但是成色还没有达到高级丹药的标准啊！
严格来说上这些都不能够算上高级丹药的，但是功效却远远超过中级丹药，只不过比不上真正的高级丹药那么强。
经过了接近二年的炼丹，他现在修为壁已经出现松动，有要突破的征兆，冯斗此时已经感觉到自己离突破就差那么一步啦！
“幻仙”此时看到冯斗的情况，他笑着说：“臭小子，你真的不错啊！居然能够在这么短的时间，就能够达到了高级丹药师的级别，这个真的是不错啊！超出我的所料之内。”
此时冯斗将一颗中级丹药咽下去，他马上就感觉到一股力量不断地攀升，不断地注入灵气海，他慢慢地控制住这股力量，因为他也担心这股力量太强了，对他的灵气海造成不必要的伤害。
随着灵气不断汇入，他一下子就已经觉得整个灵气海变得比之前大了不知多少倍，然而他体内不断地吸纳着天空中的灵气，不断地补充他体内的枯竭灵气海。
经过了接近半个时辰之后，他原本枯竭的灵气海马上变得非常之充沛。
他的嘴角露出一丝丝的笑容，因为他现在已经正式突破了灵动境进入有些人一辈子都没有突破的仙机境，一旦进入仙机境才可以真正地成为灵修者，同时他的寿命也进一步增加，按照正常来说，只有不出意外，冯斗就算从此不修炼了，他也可以活到五百岁，绝对不是什么问题的。
随着冯斗越来越强大，寿命将会越来越长，曾经有人将自己灵修达到顶级——无上境，传说之中他的生命达到了永恒，但是现在大家只是听说过传闻而已。
就连一些无上境的巨头都失去他的消息，以期说传说，不如说是传闻而已。根本就没有人可以找到，但是他到底是怎么样，无人可知了。
关于他的传闻有两种，第一个就是他穿越时空，到底去了哪里，就没有人可知啦！主要是因为他主修空间道，达到他这样的境界，穿梭时空只是简单不能够简单，只是大家并不知道他的时空节点到底是在哪里呢？
至于第二个就是他冲击更加高境界时，不幸就陨落了，但是过了几十万年，都没有人找到他陨落的地方。
当然很多人都是相信他只是穿越时空而已，正是这样就更加多人选择去寻找他的墓地，一个无上境的灵修高手，所拥有的底蕴绝非一般人可以忍受得了这样的诱惑。
冯斗此时感觉到自己的变化，所以他的内心还是非常之兴奋的，毕竟能够突破到仙机境，绝对不是简单的一件事，有些人就算是一辈子都没有办法做的，他现在只有不到十岁就已经完成了。
“幻仙”看到这一切时，他笑着说：“臭小子，真的不错啊！居然能够在那么短的时间之内就已经突破灵动境，相对来说，算不得上中等了，算不上顶级天才，不过按照你现在的情况来说，我手中合适你修炼的功法，都是不少，不过完全合适你的，就有一部，你可以拿去看看的。”
此时“幻仙”的手指一动，一道光直接进入冯斗的灵气海，他此时根本就没有办法拒绝的，两者的等级实在太大啦！
然而冯斗在里面看到“空间道”三个字，他忍不住内心的兴奋，他一直都想修炼空间道，但是苦苦找不到修炼的方式。
这一下子就仿佛找到前进的方向，他马上埋头开始修炼啦！

At this time, Feng Dou continued to refine elixirs, succeeding and failing. More and more elixirs were refined and kept in the space ring.
However, Feng Dou gradually became more and more proficient in refining intermediate elixirs, and occasionally tried to refine some similar high-level elixirs, but the quality has not yet reached the standard of high-level elixirs!
Strictly speaking, none of these can be considered high-level elixirs, but their efficacy is far greater than that of mid-level elixirs, but they are not as powerful as real high-level elixirs.
After nearly two years of alchemy, his cultivation wall has become loose and there are signs of a breakthrough. Feng Dou already feels that he is just one step away from a breakthrough!
"Huanxian" saw Feng Dou's situation at this time, he smiled and said: "You brat, you are really good! You were able to reach the level of a senior alchemist in such a short time. This is really good! It's beyond my expectations."
At this time, Feng Dou swallowed an intermediate pill. He immediately felt a force rising continuously and pouring into the sea of spiritual energy. He slowly controlled this power because he was also worried that the power was too strong and would cause unnecessary damage to his sea of spiritual energy.
As the spiritual energy continued to flow in, he suddenly felt that the entire spiritual energy sea had become countless times larger than before. However, his body continued to absorb the spiritual energy from the sky, constantly replenishing the exhausted spiritual energy sea in his body.
After nearly half an hour, his originally depleted spiritual energy became very abundant.
A smile appeared at the corner of his mouth, because he has now officially broken through the Spiritual Movement Realm and entered the Immortal Machinery Realm that some people have never broken through in their lives. Once he enters the Immortal Machinery Realm, he can truly become a spiritual practitioner. At the same time, his lifespan has also been further increased. Normally, as long as there are no accidents, even if Feng Dou stops practicing, he can live to be five hundred years old, which is definitely not a problem.
As Feng Dou becomes stronger and stronger, his lifespan will become longer and longer. There was once someone who reached the top level of spiritual cultivation - the Supreme Realm. Legend has it that his life has reached eternity, but now everyone has only heard of rumors.
Even some supreme giants have lost information about him in order to make it a legend, rather than just a rumor. No one can be found at all, but no one knows what he is like.
There are two kinds of rumors about him. The first one is that he traveled through time and space, and no one knows where he went! Mainly because he majored in Space Dao and reached his level. Traveling through time and space is only simple but not simple. But everyone doesn't know where his time and space node is?
As for the second one, when he reached a higher realm, he unfortunately fell, but after hundreds of thousands of years, no one found the place where he fell.
Of course, many people believe that he just traveled through time and space. Because of this, more and more people choose to search for his grave. A supreme spiritual master has a background that ordinary people cannot bear such temptation.
Feng Dou felt the changes in himself at this time, so he was still very excited in his heart. After all, being able to break through to the Immortal Machine Realm is definitely not an easy thing. Some people can't do it even in their lifetime. He has already accomplished it when he is less than ten years old.
When "Huanxian" saw all this, he said with a smile: "You brat, that's really good! You can actually break through the spiritual realm in such a short time. Relatively speaking, you can't be considered average or a top genius. But according to your current situation, I have a lot of techniques that are suitable for you to practice, but there is one that is completely suitable for you. You can take it and take a look."
At this time, "Huanxian" moved his finger, and a ray of light directly entered Feng Dou's spiritual energy sea. He had no way to refuse at this time. The level of the two was too great!
However, Feng Dou saw the words "Space Dao" inside, and he couldn't help but feel excited. He had always wanted to practice Space Dao, but he couldn't find a way to practice it.
It was as if he had found a way forward, and he immediately started practicing!
